project.title: Stove Protector Review Homepage
project.note: Pre-existing Stitch project — ~30 screens already designed covering the full site. Harness Designer downloads from here rather than generating new screens.

comparison-article.title: StoveGuard vs Stove Shield Comparison
comparison-article.variantNote: Chosen variant A of 3. Cleanest section structure, TOC sidebar, scannable spec table — best match to blueprint §5.2. Alternates: e29a1c55... (taller, denser), 00d5d034... (short, incomplete).

educational-guide.title: Educational Guide - Standard Layout
educational-guide.variantNote: Chosen 'Standard Layout' of 3. Most complete: hero, sectioned body, heat-resistance table, FAQ accordion, dark CTA, TOC sidebar. Alternates: e932402... ('Data Heavy' — has the orange Key Takeaway callout box, borrowed for the keyTakeaway field styling), 83387bc... ('Visual Focus').

review-article.title: StoveGuard Review: Real User Verdict
review-article.variantNote: Single screen for review-articles. Quick-verdict box with rating, product-overview lineup table, 'What users love' (pros) + 'Common complaints' (cons) callouts, Trustpilot/BBB/Reddit body sections, FAQ, 'Our take', TOC + Quick Facts sidebar. Matches blueprint §5.1.

buyer-guide.title: 10 Best Stove Top Protectors (2026)
buyer-guide.variantNote: Single screen for buyer-guides. Methodology box, numbered ranking list with per-product score/price/positives/drawbacks, what-to-look-for body, FAQ, TOC sidebar. Matches blueprint §5.3.

brand-page.title: Best GE Stove Protectors (Editorial)
brand-page.variantNote: Chosen 'Editorial' of 3 GE Brand Template variants. Has the protector-comparison table, GE model-series list, and FAQ — best match to the brand-pages schema. Alternates: f1f2cd4f... ('Visual Analysis'), 070cea40... ('High Contrast', image-led).

homepage.title: GuardYourStove.com Homepage
homepage.variantNote: Chosen of 2 near-identical homepage variants (alternate: f9114e05...). Dark hero + stat badges, brand-comparison table, 'Browse our research' category nav, 'Most recent articles', 'how we research' methodology, dark CTA.

comparison-tool.title: Interactive Comparison Tool
comparison-tool.variantNote: Chosen of 2 near-identical comparison-tool variants (alternate: 0317056...). Two brand <select> dropdowns + 'vs' badge, side-by-side spec comparison table with per-row highlight.
